relational_invariants: Every clause has direct source, assumption, or permitted derived-fact support, or a non-null clause-appropriate synthesis.
Nested canonicalization applies only to its containing maintains clause.
Nested canonicalization and postconditions may inherit only from their containing maintains clause.
Descriptor artifact IDs are globally unique across source_task and authority_artifacts; identifiers are unique within each declaration namespace.
The reserved artifact ID task_envelope appears only as source_task and never in authority_artifacts.
Every recipe-bound authority descriptor is referenced by recipe content.
Every local semantic reference resolves to a declared symbol of its declared kind.
authoring_rules: Author one complete rook.planner_graph_recipe:v1 value using only the supplied brief and authority context.
Use explicit authority-valid assumptions for material values not supplied by trusted authority, or declare honest unresolved intent.
Keep implementation representations, tools, operations, and executable payloads out of the recipe.
Keep worker slots empty and do not attach confirmation, trusted-selection, or privileged-authorization receipts.
Preserve the complete semantic contract without borrowing unreferenced facts from supplied artifacts.
non_claims: Mechanical acceptance does not establish semantic fidelity or product authorization.
Capability availability does not authorize compiled operations or execution.
The recipe does not select an implementation representation.
